sentences.en: Cycling is good exercise. Moreover, it doesn't pollute the air.
sentences.zh: 骑自行车是很好的锻炼。此外，它不会污染空气。

sentences.en: A goat, moreover, suckled me, as an ewe suckled Chloe.
sentences.zh: 一只山羊还喂养了我；正如一只母羊喂养克洛伊一样（此处的“moreover”可以理解为‘不仅如此’）。

sentences.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
sentences.zh: 房子看起来不错；而且价格也合适。
